```ts
// shared/src/types/intake.ts

import type { AdapterStatus, AgentCapability, IssueType, IssuePriority } from "./index.js";

/** 统一推荐形状 (design §3) */
export interface Recommendation<T> {
  value: T;
  rule: string;
  candidates: T[];
  excluded: { id: string; reason: string }[];
}

/** IssueDraft 规则 (design §3) */
export interface IssueDraft {
  title: Recommendation<string>;
  goal: Recommendation<string>;
  priority: Recommendation<string>;
}

/** 阻塞原因 (design §8/§9) */
export type IntakeBlockReason =
  | "no_available_adapter"
  | "no_available_capable_adapter"
  | "project_workspace_required";

/** Adapter 前提快照条目 (design §5) */
export interface PremiseAdapterState {
  effective_status: AdapterStatus;
  capability_tags: AgentCapability[];
  updated_at: string;
}

export interface RecommendationPremise {
  project_id: string;
  workspace_id: string;
  adapters: Record<string, PremiseAdapterState>;
  workflow_template_id: string;
  workflow_template_version: number;
  graph_definition_id: string | null;
  graph_definition_version: number | null;
}

export interface TopologyRecommendationValue {
  value: "sequential" | "orchestrator_subagent";
  definition_id?: string;
  definition_version?: number;
}

/** AgentRosterRecommendation (design §3/§9) — 按节点区分候选与排除 */
export interface AgentRosterRecommendation {
  value: Record<string, string>;
  rule: string;
  by_node: Record<string, {
    candidates: string[];
    excluded: { id: string; reason: string }[];
  }>;
}

export interface RoutingRecommendation {
  issue_type: Recommendation<IssueType>;
  issue_draft: IssueDraft;
  workflow_template: Recommendation<{ id: string; version: number }>;
  collaboration_topology: Recommendation<TopologyRecommendationValue>;
  agent_roster: AgentRosterRecommendation;
}

/** ConfirmationToken (design §1) */
export interface ConfirmationTokenPayload {
  nonce: string;
  issued_at: string;
  project_id: string;
  workspace_id: string;
  premise: RecommendationPremise;
  recommended: RoutingRecommendation;
}

export interface ConfirmationToken {
  payload: ConfirmationTokenPayload;
  signature: string;
}

/** ChosenPlan 判别联合 (design §9) */
export type ChosenPlan =
  | { topology: "sequential"; adapter_config_id: string }
  | { topology: "orchestrator_subagent"; definition_id: string; definition_version: number; node_assignments: Record<string, string> };

export interface ConfirmDiff {
  field: string;
  recommended: unknown;
  chosen: unknown;
}

export interface ConfirmResponse {
  issue_id: string;
  target_kind: "graph" | "run";
  target_id: string;
  diff: ConfirmDiff[];
}

export interface RecommendResponse {
  token: ConfirmationToken;
  recommendation_id: string;
  issue_type: Recommendation<IssueType>;
  issue_draft: IssueDraft;
  workflow_template: Recommendation<{ id: string; version: number }>;
  collaboration_topology: Recommendation<TopologyRecommendationValue>;
  agent_roster: AgentRosterRecommendation;
  editable: ("collaboration_topology" | "agent_roster")[];
}
```

```ts
import { createHmac, createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import type { ConfirmationToken, ConfirmationTokenPayload } from "@personahub/shared/types";

export function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string { ... }

export function computeRecommendationId(payload): string { return sha256(canonicalJson(payload)) }

export class ConfirmationTokenService {
  constructor(private secretKeyBase64: string) {}
  private get key(): Buffer { return Buffer.from(this.secretKeyBase64, "base64"); }
  sign(payload: ConfirmationTokenPayload): ConfirmationToken {
    const canonical = canonicalJson(payload);
    const signature = createHmac("sha256", this.key).update(canonical).digest("base64");
    return { payload, signature };
  }
  verify(token: ConfirmationToken): boolean {
    const canonical = canonicalJson(token.payload);
    const expected = createHmac("sha256", this.key).update(canonical).digest("base64");
    const a = Buffer.from(token.signature ?? "", "base64");
    const b = Buffer.from(expected, "base64");
    return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
  }
}

export function generateNonce(): string { return randomUUID(); }

export function loadOrCreateHmacSecret(db): string { ... }
```

Now `canonicalJson` needs to handle nested objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null. Key order ascending. Let me implement recursively.

```ts
export function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") {
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return "[" + value.map(canonicalJson).join(",") + "]";
  }
  const obj = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
  return "{" + keys.map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + canonicalJson(obj[k])).join(",") + "}";
}
```

This produces compact deterministic JSON with sorted keys. Good.

```ts
recommend(projectId, goalText): RecommendResponse {
  const project = this.projectRepo.getById(projectId);
  if (!project) throw AppError(PROJECT_NOT_FOUND);
  const workspaceId = project.default_workspace_id;
  if (!workspaceId) throw AppError(PROJECT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED, "...", undefined, { suggested_action: "..." });
  const adapters = this.agentConfigRepo.listByProject(projectId);
  const overrides = this.adapterWorkspaceStatusRepo.listForWorkspace(workspaceId);
  const overrideByAdapterId = new Map(...);

  // NO_AVAILABLE_ADAPTER check
  const anyAvailable = adapters.some(a => effectiveAdapterStatus(a, overrideByAdapterId.get(a.id) ?? null) === Available);
  if (!anyAvailable) throw AppError(NO_AVAILABLE_ADAPTER, "No adapter is available...", undefined, { suggested_action: "在 Adapter Settings 中验证适配器" });

  // NO_AVAILABLE_CAPABLE_ADAPTER check
  const anyCapable = adapters.some(a => effectiveStatus Available && hasCapability(a, Implementation));
  if (!anyCapable) throw AppError(NO_AVAILABLE_CAPABLE_ADAPTER, "...", undefined, { suggested_action });

  const template = this.workflowTemplateRepo.getDefault();
  const goalFragment = goalText.slice(0, KEYWORD_MATCH_LIMIT);
  const keywordHit = isMultiPerspectiveKeywordHit(goalFragment);

  const definition = getDefinition(WGD.id, WGD.version); // always present in current codebase
  const topology = decideTopology({ keywordHit, definitionAvailable: !!definition, definitionId: WGD.id, definitionVersion: WGD.version });

  // build roster
  let roster: AgentRosterRecommendation;
  if (topology.value.value === "sequential") {
    const nodeRoster = buildNodeRoster(adapters, overrides, "sequential", [Implementation]);
    const chosen = nodeRoster.candidates[0];
    roster = { value: { sequential: chosen }, rule: "capability_match_and_effective_availability", by_node: { sequential: nodeRoster } };
  } else {
    const byNode = {};
    const value = {};
    for (const node of definition.nodes) {
      const nodeRoster = buildNodeRoster(adapters, overrides, node.key, node.requiredCapabilities);
      byNode[node.key] = nodeRoster;
      value[node.key] = nodeRoster.candidates[0];
    }
    roster = { value, rule: "capability_match_and_effective_availability", by_node: byNode };
  }

  const issue_type = singleActiveIssueType();
  const issue_draft = deriveIssueDraft(goalText);
  const workflow_template = activeTemplateForIssueType(template);

  const recommended: RoutingRecommendation = { issue_type, issue_draft, workflow_template, collaboration_topology: topology, agent_roster: roster };

  // premise snapshot of referenced adapters
  const referencedIds = [...new Set(Object.values(roster.value))];
  const premise = this.collectPremise(projectId, workspaceId, referencedIds);

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const payload: ConfirmationTokenPayload = { nonce: generateNonce(), issued_at: now, project_id: projectId, workspace_id: workspaceId, premise, recommended };
  const token = this.tokenService.sign(payload);
  const recommendation_id = computeRecommendationId(payload);

  return { token, recommendation_id, issue_type, issue_draft, workflow_template, collaboration_topology: topology, agent_roster: roster, editable: ["collaboration_topology", "agent_roster"] };
}
```

```ts
collectPremise(projectId, workspaceId, referencedAdapterIds): RecommendationPremise {
  const adapters = this.agentConfigRepo.listByProject(projectId);
  const overrides = this.adapterWorkspaceStatusRepo.listForWorkspace(workspaceId);
  const overrideByAdapterId = new Map(overrides.map(o => [o.adapter_config_id, o]));
  const adapterSnapshot = {};
  for (const id of referencedAdapterIds) {
    const a = adapters.find(x => x.id === id);
    if (!a) continue;
    const effective = effectiveAdapterStatus(a, overrideByAdapterId.get(a.id) ?? null);
    adapterSnapshot[id] = { effective_status: effective, capability_tags: a.capability_tags, updated_at: a.updated_at };
  }
  const template = this.workflowTemplateRepo.getDefault();
  const definition = getDefinition(WGD.id, WGD.version);
  return {
    project_id: projectId,
    workspace_id: workspaceId,
    adapters: adapterSnapshot,
    workflow_template_id: template?.id ?? "",
    workflow_template_version: template?.version ?? 0,
    graph_definition_id: definition ? WGD.id : null,
    graph_definition_version: definition ? WGD.version : null,
  };
}
```

```ts
confirm(routeProjectId, token, chosen): ConfirmResponse {
  // ① verify
  if (token.payload.project_id !== routeProjectId) throw CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID;
  if (!this.tokenService.verify(token)) throw CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID;
  const { payload } = token;
  const project = this.projectRepo.getById(routeProjectId);
  if (!project) throw PROJECT_NOT_FOUND;
  const workspaceId = payload.workspace_id;
  if (project.default_workspace_id !== workspaceId) throw CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID; // workspace must belong to project's default
  const workspace = this.workspaceRepo.getById(workspaceId);
  if (!workspace || workspace.project_id !== project.id) throw CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID;

  // ② idempotent by nonce
  const existing = this.confirmationRepo.getByNonce(payload.nonce);
  if (existing) return { issue_id: existing.issue_id, target_kind: existing.target_kind, target_id: existing.target_id, diff: [] };

  // ③ expiry
  const issuedMs = Date.parse(payload.issued_at);
  if (Date.now() - issuedMs > 30*60*1000) throw RECOMMENDATION_STALE with changed...

  // prepareGraph for graph branch (outside tx)
  let preflight: GraphPreflight | null = null;
  if (chosen.topology === "orchestrator_subagent") {
    const definition = getDefinition(chosen.definition_id, chosen.definition_version);
    if (!definition) throw GRAPH_DEFINITION_UNAVAILABLE;  // or TOPOLOGY_NOT_EXECUTABLE
    // check node_assignments keys exactly == definition node set
    ... validate
    preflight = prepareGraph(workspace.local_path, workspaceId, definition, chosen.definition_id, chosen.definition_version);
  }

  // build recommendation event payload + diff
  const diff = computeDiff(payload.recommended, chosen);

  const result = this.db.transaction(() => {
    // ④ premise re-collect + compare
    const freshPremise = this.recommendationService.collectPremise(project.id, workspaceId, Object.keys(payload.premise.adapters));
    const changed = comparePremise(payload.premise, freshPremise);
    if (changed.length) throw AppError(RECOMMENDATION_STALE, ..., undefined, { changed });

    // ⑤ validate user's chosen adapters
    validateChosen(payload, chosen, project.id, workspaceId);

    // create issue
    const created = this.issueService.create(project.id, {
      title: payload.recommended.issue_draft.title.value,
      goal: payload.recommended.issue_draft.goal.value,
      priority: payload.recommended.issue_draft.priority.value,
    });
    const issueId = created.issue.id;
    const threadId = created.primary_thread.id;

    // coordinator.recommendation_applied event (write only)
    const coordinatorEvent = this.threadEventService.write(threadId, ThreadEventType.CoordinatorRecommendationApplied, ActorType.System, null, {
      rules: [...rule names...],
      recommended: {...payload.recommended...},
      chosen: {...chosen...},
      diff,
    });
    pendingEvents.push(coordinatorEvent);

    // build execution unit
    let targetKind, targetId;
    if (chosen.topology === "sequential") {
      const seq = createSequentialRun(this.sequentialDeps, issueId, threadId, workspaceId, project.id, chosen.adapter_config_id);
      targetKind = "run"; targetId = seq.runId;
      pendingEvents.push(...seq.pendingEvents);
    } else {
      const graphResult = createGraph(this.graphDeps, issueId, threadId, workspaceId, project.id, plan, preflight);
      targetKind = "graph"; targetId = graphResult.graphRunId;
      pendingEvents.push(...graphResult.pendingEvents);
    }

    // ⑥ INSERT intake_confirmations last
    this.confirmationRepo.create({ nonce, project_id, workspace_id, recommendation_id: computeRecommendationId(payload), chosen_json: JSON.stringify(chosen), issue_id: issueId, target_kind: targetKind, target_id: targetId, issued_at: payload.issued_at, confirmed_at: new Date().toISOString() });

    return { issueId, targetKind, targetId };
  })();

  // after commit: broadcast + drain
  for (const e of pendingEvents) this.threadEventService.broadcast(e);
  await this.drainWorkspace(workspaceId);

  return { issue_id: result.issueId, target_kind: result.targetKind, target_id: result.targetId, diff };
}
```

```ts
function computeDiff(recommended: RoutingRecommendation, chosen: ChosenPlan): ConfirmDiff[] {
  const diffs: ConfirmDiff[] = [];
  // topology
  const recTopo = recommended.collaboration_topology.value.value;
  if (recTopo !== chosen.topology) {
    diffs.push({ field: "collaboration_topology", recommended: recTopo, chosen: chosen.topology });
  }
  // roster
  if (chosen.topology === "sequential") {
    const chosenRoster = { sequential: chosen.adapter_config_id };
    const recRoster = recommended.agent_roster.value;
    if (JSON.stringify(recRoster) !== JSON.stringify(chosenRoster)) {
      diffs.push({ field: "agent_roster", recommended: recRoster, chosen: chosenRoster });
    }
  } else {
    const recRoster = recommended.agent_roster.value;
    if (JSON.stringify(recRoster) !== JSON.stringify(chosen.node_assignments)) {
      diffs.push({ field: "agent_roster", recommended: recRoster, chosen: chosen.node_assignments });
    }
  }
  return diffs;
}
```

Let me define the premise comparison. comparePremise(expected, fresh): returns changed[] of { field, expected, actual } or list of field names.

```ts
function comparePremise(expected: RecommendationPremise, fresh: RecommendationPremise): string[] {
  const changed: string[] = [];
  if (expected.project_id !== fresh.project_id) changed.push("project_id");
  if (expected.workspace_id !== fresh.workspace_id) changed.push("workspace_id");
  if (expected.workflow_template_id !== fresh.workflow_template_id) changed.push("workflow_template_id");
  if (expected.workflow_template_version !== fresh.workflow_template_version) changed.push("workflow_template_version");
  if (expected.graph_definition_id !== fresh.graph_definition_id) changed.push("graph_definition_id");
  if (expected.graph_definition_version !== fresh.graph_definition_version) changed.push("graph_definition_version");
  const adapterKeys = new Set([...Object.keys(expected.adapters), ...Object.keys(fresh.adapters)]);
  for (const key of adapterKeys) {
    const exp = expected.adapters[key];
    const fr = fresh.adapters[key];
    if (!exp || !fr) { changed.push(`adapter.${key}`); continue; }
    if (exp.effective_status !== fr.effective_status) changed.push(`adapter.${key}.effective_status`);
    if (JSON.stringify(exp.capability_tags) !== JSON.stringify(fr.capability_tags)) changed.push(`adapter.${key}.capability_tags`);
    if (exp.updated_at !== fr.updated_at) changed.push(`adapter.${key}.updated_at`);
  }
  return changed;
}
```

```ts
function validateChosen(projectId, workspaceId, chosen, definition, adapterDeps) {
  if (chosen.topology === "sequential") {
    const r = resolveEligibleAdapter(adapterDeps, projectId, workspaceId, { explicitAdapterId: chosen.adapter_config_id, requiredCapabilities: [Implementation] });
    if (!r.ok) {
      if (r.errorCode === ErrorCode.ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE || r.errorCode === ErrorCode.ADAPTER_NOT_FOUND) {
        throw new AppError(ErrorCode.RECOMMENDATION_STALE, "Chosen adapter is no longer available.", undefined, { changed: ["agent_roster.sequential"] });
      }
      throw new AppError(r.errorCode, `Adapter '${chosen.adapter_config_id}' is not eligible for implementation.`);
    }
  } else {
    for (const node of definition.nodes) {
      const r = resolveEligibleAdapter(adapterDeps, projectId, workspaceId, { explicitAdapterId: chosen.node_assignments[node.key], requiredCapabilities: node.requiredCapabilities });
      if (!r.ok) {
        if (r.errorCode === ErrorCode.ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE || r.errorCode === ErrorCode.ADAPTER_NOT_FOUND) {
          throw new AppError(ErrorCode.RECOMMENDATION_STALE, `Chosen adapter for node '${node.key}' is no longer available.`, undefined, { changed: [`agent_roster.${node.key}`] });
        }
        throw new AppError(r.errorCode, `Adapter for node '${node.key}' is not eligible.`);
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Let me plan the confirm() rewrite:

```ts
async confirm(routeProjectId, token, chosen): Promise<{ response: ConfirmResponse; replayed: boolean }> {
  const { payload } = token;
  // 1. verify signature FIRST
  if (!this.options.tokenService.verify(token)) {
    throw new AppError(ErrorCode.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID, "Confirmation token signature is invalid.");
  }
  // 2. route project match
  if (payload.project_id !== routeProjectId) {
    throw new AppError(ErrorCode.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID, "Token project_id does not match route.");
  }
  // 3. idempotent replay (before current-state checks)
  const existing = this.options.confirmationRepo.getByNonce(payload.nonce);
  if (existing) {
    if (existing.project_id !== routeProjectId) {
      throw new AppError(ErrorCode.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID, "Token project_id does not match route.");
    }
    return { response: { issue_id: existing.issue_id, target_kind: existing.target_kind, target_id: existing.target_id, diff: [] }, replayed: true };
  }
  // 4. current-state checks
  const project = this.options.projectRepo.getById(routeProjectId);
  if (!project) throw PROJECT_NOT_FOUND;
  if (project.default_workspace_id !== payload.workspace_id) throw CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID ...;
  const workspace = getById(payload.workspace_id);
  if (!workspace || workspace.project_id !== project.id) throw CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_INVALID;
  // 5. expiry (with future skew)
  ...
  // ... rest (premise, chosen validation, transaction)
  return { response: {...}, replayed: false };
}
```

Let me implement a strict check. The value is generated by us as `randomBytes(32).toString("base64")` which produces standard padded base64. So strict validation is fine.

```ts
function parseSecret(raw: string, name: string): Buffer {
  if (!raw) throw ...;
  const canonicalPattern = /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/;
  if (!canonicalPattern.test(raw)) {
    throw new Error(`Fatal configuration error: app secret '${name}' is not valid base64...`);
  }
  const decoded = Buffer.from(raw, "base64");
  if (decoded.toString("base64") !== raw) {
    throw new Error(`Fatal configuration error: app secret '${name}' is not canonical base64...`);
  }
  if (decoded.length !== HMAC_SECRET_BYTES) {
    throw new Error(...);
  }
  return decoded;
}
```

The regex `^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$` enforces proper base64 padding. This rejects trailing `!!!!` and wrong padding. Then `decoded.toString("base64") === raw` enforces canonical encoding.
